officialIdentity.indexFullNameEn: CSI Hong Kong Brand Name Drug Index
officialIdentity.indexCnDesc: 中证香港创新药指数在港股通范围内中选取不超过50家主营业务涉及创新药研发的上市公司证券作为指数样本，以反映香港市场创新药主题上市公司证券的整体表现。
officialIdentity.indexEnDesc: CSI Hong Kong Brand Name Drug Index selects no more than 50 securities on HKEx under Hong Kong Stock Connect which engaged R&D of brand name drug as the constituents.The index is to measure the performance of brand name drug companies under Hong Kong Stock Connect.

excluded.indexNameEnAll: CSI Hong Kong Brand Name Drug Index
